title: Leviticus Bible Quiz - Chapter 7
description: Ten questions on Leviticus 7: the laws of the trespass offering and the peace offerings, the priests' portions, and the ban on eating fat and blood.

questions.text: Who among the priests may eat the trespass offering?
questions.explanation: The trespass offering is most holy: every male among the priests may eat of it, and it must be eaten in a holy place.

questions.text: What does the priest who offers someone's burnt offering keep for himself?
questions.explanation: The priest who offers any man's burnt offering shall have for himself the skin of that burnt offering.

answers.text: The right thigh of the animal
The skin of the burnt offering

questions.text: Besides unleavened cakes and wafers, what else is offered with a peace offering for thanksgiving?
questions.explanation: With the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving he shall offer cakes of leavened bread.

questions.text: When must the meat of a peace offering for thanksgiving be eaten?
questions.explanation: It shall be eaten on the day of the offering; none of it may be left until the morning.

answers.text: On the day it is offered

questions.text: What must be done with meat of a vow or free will offering that remains on the third day?
questions.explanation: It may be eaten on the day of the sacrifice and the next day, but what remains on the third day shall be burned with fire.

answers.text: It must be burned with fire
It must be given to the priest
It must be buried outside the camp
It must be given to the poor

questions.text: What happens to someone who eats the meat of a peace offering while unclean?
questions.explanation: The soul who eats the meat of the peace offerings with his uncleanness on him shall be cut off from his people.

answers.text: He must pay a fine of silver
He must leave the camp for seven days
He is cut off from his people
He must offer a second peace offering

questions.text: What may be done with the fat of an animal that died of itself or was torn by animals?
questions.explanation: Such fat may be used for any other service, but it may in no way be eaten.

answers.text: It may be eaten after washing
It must be burned on the altar
It must be given to the Levites
It may be used for other service, but not eaten

questions.text: Which part of the peace offering is waved before Yahweh and given to Aaron and his sons?
questions.explanation: The offerer brings the fat with the breast so the breast may be waved; the priest burns the fat, but the breast is Aaron's and his sons'.

questions.text: Which part of the peace offerings is given to the priest as a heave offering?
questions.explanation: The right thigh of the peace offerings is given to the priest as a heave offering.

questions.text: Where did Yahweh command Moses these laws of the offerings?
questions.explanation: These laws were commanded to Moses in Mount Sinai, in the wilderness of Sinai.
